assumed_value: your firm factor 0.5 accepted as declared, unchecked against the battery's energy
why_it_binds: a battery is firm only for what its stored energy can sustain: with no energy rating its firm credit is the same whatever its size, so the capacity it adds to the envelope is unchecked
how_to_get_it: the battery datasheet or supplier quotation: usable energy in MWh at the discharge rate the duty needs

why_it_binds: When absent, the hybrid and full-DLC scenarios ASSUME three 1,350 kW N+1 CDUs already installed at no cost, which supplies roughly 22 racks of liquid capacity that the hall may not have.
how_to_get_it: CDU nameplates and the mechanical single-line diagram.

why_it_binds: Whether the plant can hold the water temperature the chips need.
how_to_get_it: The platform vendor's reference design for the target rack.

input: Rear-door heat exchanger capacity per rack
why_it_binds: Decides whether the rear-door scenario can host the target rack at all. When absent the engine uses a library default of 60 kW per rack (band 20-80), which is neither a manufacturer's rating nor a site measurement.
how_to_get_it: The selected rear-door unit's datasheet at the site's water temperature and airflow.

why_it_binds: Every annual energy cost, cost per GPU-hour and lifecycle figure is priced at this. When absent the engine uses a 140 EUR/MWh placeholder (band 90-220).
how_to_get_it: The supply contract, or 12 months of invoices divided by metered energy.

assumed_value: none: the lifecycle value is undiscounted
why_it_binds: When absent the lifecycle value is stated undiscounted and says so.
